items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I know there was two of us trombones was Ted Kelly... Yeah, I played with Claude up there.

ctx.x: with Claude for about two months, something like that. Joe Garland was on the band, saxophone player I mentioned that wrote In the Mood and Leap Frog and some of those things. He was on the band. Rudy Powell was on the band. He changed his name to Sid Achim or something. I don't know what name he -- but he was on the band as Rudy Powell, saxophone player.

Trying to see if I remember any of the other guys. I know there was two of us trombones was Ted Kelly. He was a drummer. I don't know if you remember him. He didn't get to be too big a name. I don't remember too many of the guys because I didn't stay there long, you know, just about a couple months. Yeah, I played with Claude up there.
You -- did you work for Norman Granz for two years, in '46 and '47, before you left or was that just --
